candidate_relations.reason: Rasmussen encephalitis can cause progressive hemispheric atrophy and seizures, but the ipsilateral calvarial thickening, compensatory sinus hyperpneumatization, ex vacuo ventricular dilation, and remote cystic encephalomalacia support Dyke-Davidoff-Masson syndrome from an early-life cerebral insult rather than progressive inflammatory encephalitis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Alternative differential for unilateral cerebral atrophy and refractory focal seizures, not the requested Dyke-Davidoff-Masson syndrome.
